name: thinking-game-newlife-refoundation-ai-function
description: Isolated live provider for the NEW LIFE refoundation vertical slice (V13-V24 turn ontology, V27 ending vector, V31 NPC generation contract). One stateless HTTP Cloud Function, two operations (interpret_turn / generate_npc_line). Separate from functions/dialogue/ (CASE1) and functions/newlife-dialogue/ (legacy NEW LIFE) -- does not reuse their response ontology or character set. Holds no secret material -- authenticates to Vertex AI via the function's own Cloud Run service account (Application Default Credentials), never a hardcoded API key. Never persists anything, never logs request bodies or player free text.
